title: Fragrant Kimchi Stir-Fry Bowl
description: A delicious culinary creation crafted to utilize the kimchi in your fridge, balanced for 2 people in Singapore.
ingredients: 2 fresh eggs or pan-seared firm tofu
1 tbsp sesame oil and minced garlic
1 tsp toasted sesame seeds and chopped scallions
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add your kimchi and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes to release deep aromas.
Toss in cooked rice and incorporate evenly until well seasoned.
Top with a fried egg or golden protein, garnish with scallions, and serve hot!
